Container.Name: plex-audiofix
Container.Overview: Puts your preferred-language audio track first and default in every MKV/MP4 so Plex downloads play the right language. Lossless remux. Scans hourly and fixes new imports instantly via a Sonarr/Radarr webhook.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Map this EXACTLY like Sonarr/Radarr do (same host folder, same container path) so no path mapping is needed.

Config.Name: Preferred languages
Config.Description: Priority order, e.g. eng or eng,spa

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: true = only log what would change. Set false after checking the log.

Config.Name: Plex path map
Config.Description: Only if Plex sees media at a different path: /data/media:/media

Config.Name: Arr path map
Config.Description: Only if Sonarr/Radarr use a different path: /tv:/data/media/tv,/movies:/data/media/movies

Config.Name: Notify URL
Config.Description: Discord webhook or ntfy topic URL for fix summaries and errors

Config.Name: Skip hardlinked
Config.Description: true = wait until the torrent is removed, then fix. false = fix now (temporarily doubles disk use while seeding).

Config.Name: Min file age (min)
Config.Description: Hourly scan skips files modified more recently than this
